The severity of 2.0 is appropriate—it's noticeable but doesn't destroy the image's realism. I agree with the Router's assessment; no new catastrophic artifacts were found by experts, but the Router's visual inspection caught the subtle fusion issue that experts might miss due to their specific limitations.
